items.title: Degree is additive in ranks under tensor product of locally free modules
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The proof reduces to a proper curve via the delivered components lemma and elementary arithmetic, and on the curve uses the delivered proper-curve lemma. The curve computation is determined by that lemma with F = V plus the definition of degree (deg(E) = chi(E) - rank(E) chi(O_X) on a curve, the same definition used inside the proof of the proper-curve lemma): chi(E  tensor  V) = rank(V) deg(E) + rank(E) chi(V) gives deg(E  tensor  V) = rank(V) deg(E) + rank(E) deg(V). H2: two delivered companions whose displayed formulae determine the identity; the substitution is the author's 'elementary arithmetic'.
